name: IIFL Finance Ltd
title: IIFL Finance Ltd - 532636 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Gold loan AUM ₹52,581 cr (+150% YoY) with 62 t tonnage; FY27 gold AUM growth guided at 20–25% and credit cost to fall to 1.5–1.7%, but tax assessment overhang and no capacity-discipline signal.

triggers.label: Credit cost to 1.5–1.7% in FY27
triggers.quote: Next year, our credit cost on the whole will be around 1.5% to 1.7%.

triggers.label: Gold AUM growth 20–25% FY27
triggers.quote: we should see AUM growth of around 20% to 25%.

triggers.label: Cost of funds could fall 100–120 bps on rating upgrade
triggers.quote: I believe that our cost of funding can go down easily by 100 to 120 basis points once the rating improves.

triggers.label: New gold loan rules from 1 April
triggers.quote: loans above INR2.5 lakh, they want the credit assessment to be done

guidance.quote: we should see AUM growth of around 20% to 25%.
Next year, our credit cost on the whole will be around 1.5% to 1.7%.
we are expecting a book growth of about 18%, 20% in FY '27 and disbursement growth would be about 25% to 27%.
We will be growing overall on around 20% odd.
the total off-book proportion, which is DA and co-lending put together will be 34%, 36% in that range. Our endeavor will be to take it to 40%, 45%.

red_flags.label: Income tax special audit and assessment pending
red_flags.quote: the process should not result in any material adverse outcome for our operations or financial positions

red_flags.label: Home finance ROE single digit, micro LAP stress
red_flags.quote: we've just reached single-digit ROE in IIFL Home Finance, right?

red_flags.label: Capital adequacy relies on off-book growth
red_flags.quote: either we improve our co-lending and off-book significantly or we raise capital.

evasions.quote: I have absolutely no idea of what is the actual demand going to be.
I don't know for 2 years. I mean, we never said that we are...
this is not a question that I can answer correctly.
